description:
This week on UnFck My Startup*, Adam Robinson and Pete Crowley bring in Anthony Pierri—the B2B founder who’s made a name by calling bulls**t on everything from fake funnels to marketing theater.

If you’ve ever looked at someone’s “growth hack” and thought, “This is absolute fluff,” this one’s for you.

Inside this episode:

🔥 Why most SaaS marketing is theater for VCs
📉 The 3 stages of lead gen decay—and how to fix them
📣 When starting beef is actually good strategy
🚀 How transparency became Anthony’s growth engine
⚠️ Why the biggest names in SaaS are quietly watching him

This is the anti-hype, anti-BS, build-in-public blueprint. Get your playbook unf*cked.
